newsitem.title: USA: BP eager to go ahead with Toledo refinery upgrade.
newsitem.headline: BP eager to go ahead with Toledo refinery upgrade.

text.p: British Petroleum Plc is eager for its U.S. subsidiary BP America to go ahead with a $235 million upgrade of its Toledo, Ohio refinery, BP group chief executive John Browne said Wednesday.
BP America officials had been quoted saying that delays in getting environmental permits for the upgrade could force them to close the plant.

But Browne said improving the plant was essential to the company's plans. "It's a very important refinery for us," Browne told a group of reporters, after speaking at a British-American Business Association luncheon.
"We have a potentially significant investment program which will make it a refinery forever," he said.
Browne said the company had not set a deadline for obtaining approvals for the improvements at the 155,000 barrels per day refinery.
"We never work like that," he said. "We have to work with the governments and local communities to the best of our mutual advantage. I believe this is very much in the interests of Ohio."
"I hope that whatever the holdups are they can be sorted out," he said.
